description: Use this when you want to survey the market instead of getting one pick: list paid agent APIs by score with filters (view="search": q, data_type, protocol, min_score, paging), or see per-category entry counts, average scores and top endpoints (view="categories"). Free, read-only. Example: browse_scoreboard(view="categories") to see which data types have reliable suppliers.

q.description: view=search: text to match in name, description and URL.

top.description: view=categories: top endpoints per data type.

view.description: search lists entries; categories summarises each data type.

name: browse_scoreboard
title: Browse the API scoreboard (free)
